content:
incident-bot: [PAGER] metering.watermark_lag > 180s (warning) — token-aggregator ingest lag spike. link: https://ops.redwood/inci/1830000000 :rotating_light:
ashley_oncall: Acked. oncall is looking :eyes:
marta_billing: seeing delayed deltas from ingest-kafka -> aggregator. offsets stuck for partition 12. last_commit: 1245823, lag ~4m. some customers showing transient overage flags in staging.
sachin_sre: can you paste the consumer group offsets? what consumer is showing high lag?
marta_billing: ```
consumer_group: metering-agg-prod
partition 12 -> current_offset=1245823, log_end_offset=1246220, lag=397
```
ashley_oncall: thanks. that's collector-consumer-12 on node g4-3. rolling-restart?
sachin_sre: propose rolling restart of metering-consumer to drain stalled fetches. command: ``kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/metering-consumer``. will do canary 1 pod first.
marta_billing: hold on with restart — overage-email worker is reading from same stream. if consumers jump we might double-count during replays. we should suppress outbound overage notifications first.
lex_cs: are any customers already notified? I saw one automated watch but no email yet. need to avoid false-positive billing notices.
ops-bot: Feature-flag check: suppress_overage_emails = false for prod.
ashley_oncall: marta, can you flip the flag? we'll do restart once suppression is on.
marta_billing: flipping now. ``curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/prod/suppress_overage_emails -d '{"value":true}'`` -> 200 OK. :white_check_mark:
sachin_sre: starting canary restart now (pod metering-consumer-5). monitoring consumer lag and commit progress.
ashley_oncall: watching offsets. sahcin/sre, ping when canary stable.
sachin_sre: canary stable after 45s. offsets moved from 1245823 -> 1246300, lag dropping. rolling remaining pods.
marta_billing: I'm pausing the alert escalator and suppressing external overage webhooks for 10m. backfill plan: run aggregator-backfill job against kafka offsets range [1245823..1246300] to ensure idempotent aggregation.
lex_cs: noted, telling CS to hold manual outreach. sending pause note to #customer-notify.
ashley_oncall: good. postmortem action: investigate root cause of consumer stall (OOM? network flaps?) and add more robust at-least-once dedupe for aggregator.
ops-bot: Metrics: metering.watermark_lag dropped below 30s at ts=1830000308.
marta_billing: re-enabled overage emails flag -> false? will re-enable after backfill completes and counts reconcile.
sachin_sre: backfill job started: job-id bf-1830000000, ETA ~6m. logs: ``Processing 47k messages, 12 partitions``
lex_cs: good. CS will follow up with customers if any residual mismatch after backfill.
ashley_oncall: monitoring. if anything regresses, escalate to SEV-1. closing interim triage in 20m. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Thread note: incident tagged billing, metering, live-mitigation.
